description: Copy source files to destination directory
command: cp -r data/source/* data/destination/ 2>/dev/null && echo 'Files copied successfully'

description: Move processed files to archive folder
command: mv data/processed/* data/archive/ 2>/dev/null && echo 'Files moved successfully'

description: Delete temporary files older than 24 hours
command: find data/temp -type f -mmin +1440 -delete 2>/dev/null && echo 'Temporary files cleaned'

description: Create backup of critical data files
command: tar -czf data/backups/data_backup.tar.gz data/critical/ 2>/dev/null && echo 'Backup created successfully'

description: Rename files with new naming convention
command: for f in data/input/*.csv; do mv
python -c 'import os; try: open("data/missing.json"); except FileNotFoundError: print("Handled missing file error")'
stat -c '%a %U' data/output/*.json 2>/dev/null | grep -q '644 root' && echo 'Permissions validated'

description: Log all file operations to audit trail
command: echo $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) - File operation logged > data/logs/operations.log 2>/dev/null && echo 'Operation logged successfully'
